{%- comment -%}
  llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org) — 이 블로그를 LLM이 읽기 좋게 소개하는 한 장. 영어로 쓴다.
  글 · 도구 · 요약본 목록은 빌드 때 _posts · _en · _data/links.yml · _data/resources.yml 에서
  자동으로 채운다. 새 글이나 도구를 넣어도 이 파일은 손대지 않아도 된다.
  (_en 의 짝을 찾는 법은 component/en-of.html 과 같다.)
{%- endcomment -%}
# tiaz.dev

> Personal tech blog by tiaz: backend, security and multi-cloud (mostly AWS), networking, Kubernetes, Python and computer-science basics, plus book notes and small interactive developer tools. Posts are written in Korean, and every post also has a full English version.

- Each post page carries both versions in the same HTML; add `?lang=en` to a post URL to open it in English (for example {{ site.url }}{{ site.posts.first.url }}?lang=en).
- Titles and descriptions below are the English versions. Dates are when a post was first published.
- Small tools and cheat sheets are available in seven languages (Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Italian, French).
- Author: tiaz ({{ site.url }}/about, GitHub: https://github.com/{{ site.github }}). Feed: {{ site.url }}/feed.xml. Sitemap: {{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml.

{%- assign tools = site.data.links | where: 'category', '유용한 도구' | first %}
{%- if tools %}

## Tools

Interactive, phone-first developer tools. A short link stores the inputs and the language.
{% for l in tools.links %}
- [{{ l.label_en | default: l.label }}]({{ site.url }}{{ l.url }}): {{ l.note_en | default: l.note }}
{%- endfor %}
{%- endif %}

## Cheat sheets

Free animated HTML cheat sheets that also print as PDF.
{% assign docs = site.data.resources | sort: 'order' -%}
{% for d in docs %}
{%- assign en_slug = d.slugs.en | default: d.slug %}
- [{{ d.title_en | default: d.title }}]({{ site.url }}/resources/{{ en_slug }}.html): {{ d.summary_en | default: d.summary }} ({{ d.pages }} pages; PDF: {{ site.url }}/resources/{{ en_slug }}.pdf)
{%- endfor %}

{%- endfor %}
